brain.commentary: Broad cross-asset stress, uniformly flat or weak signals, and moderate institutional advisory risk warrant reduced aggregate exposure. Signals are especially fragile for ETC/USD due to a zero price, zero volatility, and zero liquidity data; BCH/USD due to strongly negative alpha, institutional score, liquidity, and highest expected shortfall; and LTC/USD due to very weak liquidity. The isolated ETC long signal is not actionable without valid market data.
